seed_variation.verdict: Only one seed was run, so there is no seed variation to measure.
seed_variation.why: TextRank (summa) has no random step: PageRank over a sentence-similarity graph, fixed input order. The seed cannot change the summary, so every seed should give the same text and std 0. Each seed sets Python random, NumPy and torch. PYTHONHASHSEED is fixed to the FIRST seed for the whole run.
